distribution.summary: 广东；广西；福建；海南；云南；台湾
distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) records Hainan, Yunnan and Taiwan. Lin et al. (2021) adds field records from Yunnan, Hainan, Fujian, Guangxi and Guangdong. Beaver & Liu (2010) independently reports the first Taiwan record in its treatment, based on 130 specimens from Ilan, Nantou, Pingtung and Taitung.

host_note: Lin et al. (2021) reports five identified hosts from Chinese field collections: Eucalyptus robusta, Eucalyptus sp., Hevea brasiliensis, Schefflera octophylla and Sindora glabra. Beaver & Liu (2010) characterizes X. affinis as strongly polyphagous with hundreds of host species reported, but no additional host taxon is enumerated in the curated field; no new host is promoted.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Xyleborus affinis Eichhoff, 1868.
